name: Hotel Bergland
beschreibung: Hotel Bergland is located in Sillian in the Hochpustertal, near the border with Südtirol. The quiet location a little above the village center offers a view of the Lienzer Dolomiten. The hotel's amenities include comfortable rooms and a restaurant with Tiroler Küche. A wellness area with sauna is available to guests. In summer, the hiking trails and the Drauradweg are directly accessible. In winter, guests use the nearby Sillianer Geier ski area. The family-run establishment values personal attention. Guests can expect an uncomplicated accommodation for active vacation days in Osttirol.
